processes.realtime_desk_position_instructions: Trading lead emails the real-time desk the day's length/short position, books, and Enpower deal entry instructions the operators must key.
processes.intercompany_annuity_and_deal_adjustment: Correcting or booking Enpower deals, annuities, and PMA/settlement adjustments between books with settlements and risk staff, including explanations and reversals.
processes.shift_schedule_issue_reporting: Real-time shift operators report missed schedules, system failures or unfinalized DA/HA finals to the desk lead, who must follow up and fix.
processes.desk_staffing_access_requests: Requests to support groups for trader IDs, handsets, turret setup, program sign-ups and shift coverage.
